Humble Robotics raises $51 million for autonomous electric freight

The Series A supports customer pilots, validation and early manufacturing for regional freight.

Business Wire / Yahoo Finance ↗5 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Funding the next development stage

Humble Robotics announced a $51 million Series A on November 5, led by Obvious Ventures with Eclipse, Energy Impact Partners and others participating. Total funding reaches $75 million. Proceeds support customer pilots, testing, validation and early manufacturing.

Vehicle and autonomy together

Humble develops electric Class 8 vehicles and autonomy as one platform. It focuses on regional routes under 250 miles connecting ports, rail terminals, warehouses and distribution centers, including the complex maneuvers required around freight handling areas.

Commercial preparation continues

The modular platform is intended to support additional vehicle configurations. Humble is working with customers, partners and regulators toward commercial deployment. This is a funding update, not the Hauler’s original unveiling, and it does not establish driverless commercial service on every targeted route.
